test.create_query: CREATE TABLE cmp_uuid_ip ( uuid_a UUID, uuid_b UUID, ipv4_a IPv4, ipv4_b IPv4, ipv6_a IPv6, ipv6_b IPv6, fs16_a FixedString(16), fs16_b FixedString(16) ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO cmp_uuid_ip SELECT uuid_a, if(rand() % 2 = 0, uuid_a, generateUUIDv4()), ipv4_a, if(rand() % 2 = 0, ipv4_a, toIPv4(rand())), ipv6_a, if(rand() % 2 = 0, ipv6_a, CAST(randomFixedString(16), 'IPv6')), fs16_a, if(rand() % 2 = 0, fs16_a, randomFixedString(16)) FROM ( SELECT generateUUIDv4() AS uuid_a, toIPv4(rand()) AS ipv4_a, CAST(randomFixedString(16), 'IPv6') AS ipv6_a, randomFixedString(16) AS fs16_a FROM numbers(20000000) )
test.query: SELECT count() FROM cmp_uuid_ip WHERE {type}_a < (SELECT {type}_a FROM cmp_uuid_ip LIMIT 1)
